text: How long may we hold on to the record of when members visited the clubs?
note: Answer is a denial ('not longer than 18 months'). Traps: receipts 7 years in the same message, Sentry logs 30 days, 'not 24 like my first draft', the spec's 'to be confirmed'.

text: Will people be able to put their membership on hold through the app?
note: Yes only if Paystride ships the pause endpoint by 20 March; the button is behind a flag until then.

text: Has the client signed off on the membership prices shown on the plans page?
note: Grace approved the section structure only; prices are placeholders. Jamie P's 'Grace approved the plans screen' over-claims.

text: Did we agree to make a smartwatch version of the app?
note: Theo's Watch companion idea was deferred again and again ('after launch', 'April', 'not now'); never decided.

text: Up to what point can members back out of a booked class without a penalty?
note: Spec says 2 hours, Martin demands 12 hours at the review; nobody decided and the build keeps 2 hours.

text: When is the app going out to the public?
note: Plan says 14 April; Grace demands 1 April for the campaign; Nora never got back, Grace was on holiday.

text: How many friends can a Premium member bring along each month?
note: Spec says 2 guest passes, Martin says 1 (Black gets 2); Grace promised to check and never came back. Black's 4 in the spec is a trap.

text: Do class reminders currently go out by email as well as push notification?
note: Push + email agreed on 24 Feb (still in the spec), cancelled on 12 Mar with a short 'drop the mails, push only'. Another client's 'email only' is a trap.

text: How do members currently log in to the app?
note: Membership number + 4-digit PIN agreed at kickoff and still in the spec; replaced on 9 Mar by magic links.

text: Is booking a session with a personal trainer part of the first release now?
note: PT booking was in v1 at kickoff and in the spec; Martin pulled it to phase 2 on 17 Mar.

text: What did Jamie from the club ask to be displayed when a member is scanned at reception?
note: Two Jamies: club manager Jamie Holt asked for photo, name and expiry date in red; agency Android dev Jamie Prentice talks about a tick animation and a Pixel 6 crash on the same screen.

text: How much is PulseFit spending on paid ads for the app launch?
note: The campaign exists but its budget is never stated. Traps: agency fee £48,500, Apple account £79, another client's £20k launch budget.

text: How many clubs get the new door QR readers in the first wave?
note: 5 clubs (all except Eastgate and Millbrook). Traps: spec lists all 7 clubs, '7 × 2 = 14 devices'.

text: What is the longest a waiting list for a single class can get?
note: 8 per class; the bare '8' needs its question. Traps: ClubDesk's 10, weekly limit of 10 bookings, capacity 20–25.
